{{Quote|We... we will not be panicked by a rumor! Why... Darth Vader may be using you... to test our neutrality-!|Temora, to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="live" />}}
'''Temora''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a major business leader on the planet [[Arda II]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Temora was an executive at a company that manufactured [[T-6 diodem]]s, a device they sold to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] for use in their [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], as well to local buyers for use in home service machines. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], however, Rebel leaders [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] visited Arda II, alleging to Temora that the diodems had fallen into the hands of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], which allowed it to target Rebel [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and giving it a major combat advantage. Temora, who was unaware of how the Empire obtained the diodems, soon learned that colleague [[Mag Doum]]&mdash;secretly an Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spy]]&mdash;was the source of the leak. The revelation caused a near-riot and ultimately the arrival of an Imperial battle group led by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], whom Doum had tipped off about the Rebels' presence on Arda II. Although Temora was loath to forsake Arda II's official neutrality and fully back the Alliance, the executive reached a deal with Skywalker accepting Rebel defense in exchange for assistance rectifying the Empire's new advantage. The Rebels managed to fight Vader off in the [[Attack on Arda II|ensuing battle]], further cementing their new partnership.<ref name="live" />

==Behind the scenes==
Temora appeared in the [[Star Wars (comic strip)|comic strip]] story arc ''[[As Long As We Live...]]'', written by [[Don Christensen]] and released in [[1980]]. In the comic, Temora was illustrated by [[Russ Manning]].<ref name="live" />
